description: Header file defining the RFCManager class, related enums, macros, and includes for RFC management functionality in a network device.

classes.name: RFCManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing RFC requests, device status checks, and network connectivity within the RFC namespace.

methods.name: RFCManagerProcessXconfRequest
methods.description: Processes Xconf requests related to RFC.

methods.name: CheckDeviceIsOnline

methods.name: manageCronJob

methods.name: IsIarmBusConnected
methods.description: Checks if IARM bus is connected.
